name: Granola
description_en:
Granola is a bot-free AI notepad that combines a person’s notes with captured meeting audio to produce a fuller record. The legacy granola.so website currently redirects to granola.ai, which provides the official product and plan material.

It emphasizes personal notes, meeting context and later retrieval rather than inviting another participant bot. Device capture still requires the right setup and clear handling of what will be recorded and shared.
description_zh:
Granola 是无会议机器人的 AI 笔记本，结合个人笔记与所捕捉会议音频生成更完整记录。旧 granola.so 当前重定向至 granola.ai，本次官方产品及套餐来源均在新站。

它强调个人笔记、会议背景和后续查询，而非邀请额外机器人参会。设备捕捉仍需正确配置，并明确录制及分享范围。

sections.title_en: Device audio plus the notes you write
sections.title_zh: 设备音频加个人所写笔记
sections.en: The homepage says Granola uses computer audio, works alongside meeting apps and does not invite a bot. It describes before-meeting briefs, AI-enhanced notes, meeting chat and follow-up material, with desktop and mobile apps. These generated artifacts are not an independently verified transcript of everything said. Missing capture or ambiguous speakers can affect later answers.
sections.zh: 首页说明 Granola 使用电脑音频、可与会议应用共同使用且不邀请机器人，介绍会前背景、AI 增强笔记、会议聊天及后续材料，并提供桌面和移动应用。这些生成材料并非经独立核实的完整发言记录。捕捉缺失或说话者模糊会影响后续回答。

sections.title_en: Example: preserve decisions from a design review
sections.title_zh: 示例：保留设计评审决策
sections.en: Write brief notes marking the decision and unresolved questions during a pilot review. Let Granola enhance them, then compare the proposed action list with your notes and the available meeting record. Correct owners or dates before sharing a folder or exporting to another app. Bot-free capture changes the collection method; it does not make consent, access controls or human review unnecessary. No meeting was recorded here.
sections.zh: 试点评审时简记决策和未决问题，交给 Granola 增强后，把候选行动清单与个人笔记及可用记录对照。分享文件夹或导出到其他应用前，应纠正负责人及日期。无机器人只改变收集方式，不会消除同意、访问控制或人工核对需求。本文未录制会议。

sections.en: Basic lists $0 with limited meeting history, AI notes/chat, shared folders and templates. Business lists $14/user/month with unlimited notes/history, advanced integrations, MCP and API access. Enterprise lists $35/user/month and adds SSO, organization-wide auto-deletion and sharing/API administration. The page offers individual training opt-out and organization-wide opt-out on Enterprise; do not rewrite that as a universal default prohibition. Billing cadence and exact Basic history window require confirmation.
sections.zh: Basic 为零美元，含有限会议历史、AI 笔记聊天、共享文件夹和模板。Business 每人每月 14 美元，含不限笔记历史、高级集成、MCP 与 API；Enterprise 每人每月 35 美元，增加 SSO、组织自动删除及分享/API 管理。页面提供个人退出模型训练和 Enterprise 全组织退出，不能改写为所有账户默认禁止训练。结算周期及 Basic 历史窗口仍需确认。

sections.title_zh: 试点捕捉与跨会议回答
sections.en: Start with a supported app, check audio permissions and calendar behavior, and use non-sensitive meeting content. Ask a question whose answer can be traced to a specific note, then inspect the supporting context and a meeting outside the intended sharing group. Granola fits personal meeting-memory workflows; it does not itself establish approved organizational records. Source licensing, contractual retention and deletion across integrations remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先选受支持应用，检查音频权限和日历行为，并使用非敏感会议内容。提出能追溯到具体笔记的问题，查看支持背景，同时检查不在目标分享组的会议。它适合个人会议记忆流程，但不自动形成经组织批准的记录。源码许可、合同保留及跨集成删除仍未核实。
